environment.version: PostgreSQL 17.10 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX ledger_line_enterprise_created_request_idx ON public.ledger_line USING btree (enterprise_id, created_at, ai_request_id)
CREATE INDEX ledger_line_enterprise_resource_created_idx ON public.ledger_line USING btree (enterprise_id, provider_resource_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX ledger_line_enterprise_resource_request_idx ON public.ledger_line USING btree (enterprise_id, provider_resource_id, ai_request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_line_pkey ON public.ledger_line USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ledger_line_principal_idx ON public.ledger_line USING btree (principal_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ledger_line_request_idx ON public.ledger_line USING btree (ai_request_id)

CREATE INDEX ledger_line_resource_month_cover_idx ON public.ledger_line USING btree (enterprise_id, provider_resource_id, created_at) INCLUDE (ai_request_id, raw_input_tokens, raw_output_tokens, api_cost, deducted_quota)
CREATE INDEX ledger_line_resource_settled_idx ON public.ledger_line USING btree (enterprise_id, provider_resource_id, COALESCE(settled_at, created_at) DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_line_unique_usage_event_idx ON public.ledger_line USING btree (usage_event_id)
CREATE INDEX ledger_transaction_enterprise_created_idx ON public.ledger_transaction USING btree (enterprise_id, created_at DESC, ai_request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_transaction_pkey ON public.ledger_transaction USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ledger_transaction_request_text_trgm_idx ON public.ledger_transaction USING gin (((ai_request_id)::text) gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_transaction_unique_request ON public.ledger_transaction USING btree (ai_request_id)
CREATE INDEX provider_resource_archive_idx ON public.provider_resource USING btree (enterprise_id, archived_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_resource_enterprise_id_id_uq ON public.provider_resource USING btree (enterprise_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_resource_enterprise_id_uq ON public.provider_resource USING btree (enterprise_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_resource_pkey ON public.provider_resource USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX provider_resource_pool_idx ON public.provider_resource USING btree (enterprise_id, resource_pool_id, status)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX usage_bucket_aggregate_dimensions_uq ON public.usage_bucket_aggregate USING btree (enterprise_id, bucket_granularity, bucket_start, timezone, source_principal_id, project_principal_id, provider_resource_id, unified_model_id) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
CREATE INDEX usage_bucket_aggregate_dirty_idx ON public.usage_bucket_aggregate USING btree (enterprise_id, dirty, bucket_start) WHERE (dirty = true)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX usage_bucket_aggregate_pkey ON public.usage_bucket_aggregate USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX usage_bucket_aggregate_range_idx ON public.usage_bucket_aggregate USING btree (enterprise_id, bucket_granularity, bucket_start)
